component.name: ProbeScene
component.script:
' Case A mirrors an app's home grid: row 1 is a one-item "banner" row with its own rowItemSize and ' rowHeights entry. The row is removed in place with content.removeChildren() while the focus is on row 0, ' and rowItemSize/rowHeights are left as they were (9 entries for 8 rows in the app; here 5 for 4). ' Case B removes the same row and then re-assigns rowItemSize/rowHeights for the 4 rows left (control). sub init() m.seq = 0 m.list = invalid m.kase = "" m.global.addFields({ serial: 0, probeNodes: [] }) m.timer = m.top.findNode("stepTimer") m.timer.observeField("fire", "runSteps") m.steps = [] for each kase in ["A", "B"] m.steps.push({ op: "create", kase: kase }) m.steps.push({ op: "wait", secs: 2 }) m.steps.push({ op: "dump", phase: "before" }) m.steps.push({ op: "shot", name: kase + "-before" }) m.steps.push({ op: "remove" }) m.steps.push({ op: "wait", secs: 2 }) m.steps.push({ op: "dump", phase: "removed" }) m.steps.push({ op: "shot", name: kase + "-removed" }) m.steps.push({ op: "key", key: "Down" }) m.steps.push({ op: "dump", phase: "down" }) m.steps.push({ op: "shot", name: kase + "-down" }) end for m.steps.push({ op: "done" }) m.timer.duration = 1 m.timer.control = "start" end sub
sub rec(phase as string, kase as string, detail as string) m.seq = m.seq + 1 print "PROBE|" + right("00" + m.seq.toStr(), 3) + "|" + phase + "|" + kase + "|" + detail end sub
sub runSteps() while m.steps.count() > 0 s = m.steps.shift() if s.op = "create" createList(s.kase) else if s.op = "wait" m.timer.duration = s.secs m.timer.control = "start" return else if s.op = "key" or s.op = "shot" if s.op = "key" rec("await", s.key, "case=" + m.kase) else rec("await", "shot", "name=" + s.name) end if m.timer.duration = 3 m.timer.control = "start" return else if s.op = "remove" removeBanner() else if s.op = "dump" dumpPhase(s.phase) else if s.op = "done" rec("done", "end", "serial=" + m.global.serial.toStr()) m.top.probeExit = true return end if end while end sub
function buildContent() as object colors = ["0x3060C0FF", "0xC03060FF", "0x30A060FF", "0xA08020FF", "0x8040C0FF"] names = ["featured", "banner", "recommended", "movies", "more"] counts = [6, 1, 8, 8, 8] root = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") root.title = "root" for r = 0 to counts.count() - 1 row = root.createChild("ContentNode") row.title = names[r] row.id = names[r] for c = 0 to counts[r] - 1 item = row.createChild("ContentNode") item.title = names[r] + "-" + c.toStr() item.hdPosterUrl = colors[(r + c) mod colors.count()] end for end for return root end function
sub createList(kase as string) if m.list <> invalid then m.top.removeChild(m.list) m.kase = kase m.global.probeNodes = [] l = CreateObject("roSGNode", "RowList") l.id = "list" + kase l.translation = [100, 60] l.itemComponentName = "ProbeItem" l.itemSize = [1720, 300] l.numRows = 4 l.rowFocusAnimationStyle = "fixedFocus" l.vertFocusAnimationStyle = "fixedFocus" l.showRowLabel = [true, false, true, true, true] l.rowLabelOffset = [[0, 8]] l.rowItemSpacing = [[20, 0]] l.rowItemSize = [[400, 240], [1600, 100], [220, 300], [220, 300], [220, 300]] l.rowHeights = [320, 140, 380, 380, 380] l.content = buildContent() m.top.appendChild(l) m.list = l l.setFocus(true) rec("create", kase, "rows=" + l.content.getChildCount().toStr()) end sub
sub removeBanner() root = m.list.content banner = root.getChild(1) root.removeChildren([banner]) if m.kase = "B" m.list.rowItemSize = [[400, 240], [220, 300], [220, 300], [220, 300]] m.list.rowHeights = [320, 380, 380, 380] end if rec("remove", m.kase, "rows=" + root.getChildCount().toStr() + " row1=" + root.getChild(1).title) end sub
function fmtArr(a) as string if a = invalid then return "invalid" return FormatJson(a) end function
function fmtRect(r) as string return "[" + r.x.toStr() + "," + r.y.toStr() + "," + r.width.toStr() + "," + r.height.toStr() + "]" end function
sub dumpPhase(phase as string) l = m.list rec(phase, m.kase, "list rows=" + l.content.getChildCount().toStr() + " rowItemFocused=" + fmtArr(l.rowItemFocused) + " itemFocused=" + l.itemFocused.toStr() + " rowItemSize=" + fmtArr(l.rowItemSize) + " rowHeights=" + fmtArr(l.rowHeights)) for each n in m.global.probeNodes c = n.itemContent t = "invalid" if c <> invalid then t = c.title rec(phase, m.kase, n.id + " title=" + t + " rowIndex=" + n.rowIndex.toStr() + " index=" + n.index.toStr() + " w=" + n.width.toStr() + " h=" + n.height.toStr() + " visible=" + n.visible.toStr() + " rect=" + fmtRect(n.sceneBoundingRect()) + " focus=" + n.itemHasFocus.toStr()) end for end sub
